saints.name: St. Margaret of Scotland
saints.title: Queen
saints.shortBlurb: The saintly queen who reformed the Church of Scotland and gave herself to prayer and the poor…
biography: Born about 1045 of the exiled English royal house and raised in Hungary, Margaret came to Scotland and married King Malcolm III around 1070. A wife and mother of eight children — among them a king who became St. David and a queen of England — she united a devout private life of prayer, fasting, and reading with tireless charity to orphans and the poor.

She worked to reform the customs and worship of the Scottish Church, promoted synods, founded and restored churches, and softened the manners of the court. She died at Edinburgh on 16 November 1093, only days after her husband and eldest son fell in battle. She is a patroness of Scotland.
saints.knownFor: Reform of the Scottish Church and her charity as queen.
